title: Commie Blocks Are Pretty Good, Actually
summary: Adam Something gives a short, tongue-in-cheek defense of Soviet-era prefab apartment blocks. He argues they offer efficient, dense housing with schools and services built nearby.
why: Linked in housing and urbanism threads as a fun, deliberately provocative case that dense blocks are better than their reputation.
